prompt: "Write a behavior tree for the robot to execute the command using only available nodes. If object is visible, approach and execute task. If not, scan or patrol area. Finale condition. list of available nodes: <Action ID = MoveToObj    /> <Action ID = TakeObj    /> <Condition ID = ObjIsHeavy    /> <Action ID = MoveSlowly    /> <SubTree ID = ProcessObject    /> <Condition ID = IsObjectVisible    /> <Action ID = MoveToDestination    /> <Action ID = RotateObj    /> <Sequence>     <Action ID = ScanForObject    />     <Action ID = MoveToObj    />     <Condition ID = IsObjRotated    />     <Action ID = RotateObj    /> </Sequence> <Fallback>     <Sequence>         <Action ID = MoveToObj    />         <Action ID = TakeObj    />         <Condition ID = ObjIsHeavy    />         <Action ID = MoveSlowly    />         <SubTree ID = ProcessObject    />         <Action ID = MoveToDestination    />     </Sequence>     <Action ID = PatrolArea    /> </Fallback>"
code:
SEQUENCE
			IF IsObjectVisible? THEN
			SEQUENCE
				DO MoveToObj
				DO TakeObj
					IF ObjIsHeavy? THEN
					DO MoveSlowly
			ELSE
				DO ProcessObject
				DO MoveToDestination
			END
	END
